text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
How pathetic.
And here I thought this time would be different.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even Kitasan Black seemed disheartened by the race results.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, I won't be able to repay
everyone who supported me at all, will I...?"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
choice_data_list: Next time, I'll make sure we win!
There's no time to be moping around!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
choice_data_list: Let's put today's results to good use next time!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I've calmed down a bit!
This time... I'm sure I'll be fine!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"You're right.
I can't afford to just stand still...!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Even if everyone around me is strong and I feel like I'm falling behind... No, if I'm falling behind, that just means I have to bite down and hang on even harder!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Kitasan Black fire herself up
filled me with reassurance.
